title: Yogurt-Infused Greek Cottage Cheese Galaktoboureko Pie
description: A pungent, creamy, crowd-pleaser Greek dish featuring ground ginger, robata-grill, gluten-free-friendly, form=galaktoboureko, vessel=wok.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend the cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, ground ginger, lemon zest, honey, and granulated sugar until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the melted butter and beaten egg until well combined.
Cut the phyllo dough into 4 equal pieces and stack them on top of each other.
Place a piece of phyllo dough into the wok and brush with some of the melted butter.
Spoon about 1/4 of the cottage cheese mixture onto the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the phyllo dough over the filling to form a triangle, pressing the edges to seal.
Repeat with the remaining phyllo dough and filling.
Place the galaktoboureko pies on the robata grill and cook for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Dust with confectioners' sugar and serve warm.
